description.en: Original preserved Ecphora shell inspired by the frozen Miocene E. gardnerae gardnerae reference scope: rounded whorls with four projecting T-section spiral costae grown continuously from the shell wall, an open umbilical axis and a prolonged aperture canal. Real shell wall and aperture, no soft body, foot or life-mechanism assertion. Nominal75mm length, color, growth increments and display pose are artistic, not copied specimen measurements.
description.zh: 原创保存Ecphora螺壳，以冻结中新世E.gardnerae gardnerae范围启发：圆壳圈上的四道T形螺肋连续生于壳壁，开放轴向脐部与延长壳口沟，真实壳壁开口。无软体足或生活机制断言；名义75毫米、配色生长起伏与展示姿态属美术，非标本实测复制。
